_what_this_is: the profile as COMPONENTS, each bound to the algorithm that derives it. Replaces a hand-maintained document that could not be reproduced, could not go stale visibly, and could not say what it was missing.
_the_number_that_matters: 13 of 19 components are DERIVED (68%). That is the share of 'profile this installation' that costs nothing on the next tenant. The 6 DECLARED ones are hand work that must be redone, and naming them is the only way that number ever shrinks.
_how_to_use: MISSING tells you which algorithm to run. DECLARED tells you what a human still owes. DERIVED is free.
